messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@whiterocksec.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — VM evidence + special SLA carveouts

Hi Jonas,

We are finalizing the SIG questionnaire for FinServOne and need to validate Redwood's vulnerability management evidence for the past 12 months. In particular they want:

- scan cadence details (internal apps, third-party infra, container images)
- SLA timelines for critical/important CVEs and any documented exceptions (legacy/third-party exceptions)
- proof that fixes were deployed (or compensating controls) for three sampled CVEs we list below

Can you share a consolidated packet that includes the scan index, a remediation timeline for the sampled CVEs, and the current SLA exception policy? Delivery by EOD Thursday (2026-09-17) would be ideal.

Sampled CVEs: CVE-2026-1422, CVE-2025-9981, CVE-2026-0710

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20 min call if helpful.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Assurance Analyst
WhiteRock Security
[Attachment: requested-sample-list.txt (TXT, 1KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@whiterocksec.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — VM evidence + special SLA carveouts

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can assemble a concise SIG VM packet and meet your Thursday deadline. High-level plan below; detailed artifacts attached in the consolidated packet.

Plan summary:
- Deliverables (by 2026-09-17): vm-evidence-index.csv (scan metadata + timestamps), patch-roadmap.pdf (remediation timeline + proof links), redwood-sig-summary.pdf (cover note and control narratives)
- CVE sampling: for the three CVEs you listed we will include: detection timestamp, TTR/TTR (time-to-remediate milestone), patch commit or configuration change, and verification scan evidence
- SLA carveouts: we maintain a documented exception process: 1) Category A — vendor-managed legacy (30 day negotiated window), 2) Category B — mitigated but not patched (compensating controls, 90-day window), 3) Category C — emergency freeze (temporary hold with rollback plan). We'll provide the exception register and signed approvals for past instances.
- Approach: phased remediation packet to separate infrastructure vs app-level fixes; includes canary deployment notes for high-risk patches so we can show risk mitigation during rollout.

Attachments (sending now): [Attachment: vm-evidence-index.csv (CSV, 28KB)], [Attachment: patch-roadmap.pdf (PDF, 220KB)], [Attachment: redwood-sig-summary.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]

Kimberly / Ben — tagging you both for quick review. Any concerns with the exception wording above or the proposed artifacts? If you okay it I will send this packet directly to Elena and add the signed exception logs for historical entries.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — looks good overall. A couple of small edits and asks before we send to WhiteRock: 

1) SLA carveout naming: change "Category A/B/C" to "Vendor Legacy / Mitigated / Emergency Freeze" in the cover note to avoid ambiguity in SIG responses.
2) For Category "Mitigated" we need a short runbook entry that lists the compensating control, monitoring cadence, and owner (I recommend we include a link to the runbook or paste an excerpt).
3) Attach the signed exception approvals for the three most recent exceptions (redacted signatures allowed).

I've added a short form (attached) that the legal team uses to capture exception approvals; please include that as evidence for any carveouts: [Attachment: sla-exception-form.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

If you want me to reword the cover note I can provide a 2-paragraph redline. Otherwise approve and send.

-Kim
